scope: Extends the one-field source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE transaction to group 342 textStyleHandle, retargeted to a unique source STYLE provider. contract.admission: The runtime-generated AC1027 DXF source has one STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE whose existing group 342 names source STYLE handle 0x31, plus a unique alternate STYLE MLEADER_ALT_TEXT at source handle 0x33. The caller changes only textStyleHandle to that source provider. Existing writer graph validation requires the reference to resolve to exactly one target of STYLE kind.
contract.output: The transaction authenticates the original raw group-342 value against the captured typed handle, admits exactly one changed field, projects and emits the remapped reference, then inspects emitted typed data against the writer's source-to-output handle maps. Fresh import verifies that exactly one raw group-342 field names the emitted alternate STYLE and that typed textStyleHandle resolves to its emitted handle.
contract.failureAndRetry: A dangling target 0x55 and wrong-kind LTYPE target 0x30 each refuse before publication for ASCII and binary output. Both preserve a pre-existing destination and the caller's invalid reference. Correcting the same caller object to source STYLE 0x33 and retrying with the same dx_iface succeeds and passes fresh output inspection/readback.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. Source and output are authored at runtime and removed by the focused test; no DWG/DXF fixture files are committed.
contract.limits: This is one AC1027 DXF MLEADERSTYLE group-342 edit profile. It does not qualify group 341 or 343, repeated/missing fields, multiple edits, other source/target versions, producer variation, text/font rendering, native annotation semantics, complete document closure, external semantic evidence or 3D support.
